name: Scaena OS
tagline: Four agents run an independent artist's booking pipeline: venue research, pitches, follow-ups and tracking.
problem: Emerging artists lose hours to venue research and cold outreach that rarely gets replies.
solution: Agents on Agentverse research venues and rates with grounded search, write personalised pitches sent from the artist's Gmail, then manage outreach and a pipeline view.
demo_moment: Team-described: set up a profile and watch venue scores stream in a terminal-style log.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Sends real outreach from the artist's own account.

lessons: Agents earn their keep on repetitive outreach a user hates.
